title: Prepare client alignment before status update
claim: When a client alignment meeting has unresolved decisions, prepare decision options and risks before drafting status communication.
context: Use for daily planning, client delivery steering, and meeting preparation.
boundaries: Do not send external communication without human approval.
Do not invent delivery commitments, owners, or deadlines.
raw_text: Tomorrow's client alignment should not start from a generic status update. Prepare the former context, open decisions, options, risks, and desired outcome first.
